script_text: Aquarius, Air sign ruled by Uranus in Taurus in your 2nd House, this week bends your future before you brace. Wednesday's Mars sextile Uranus brings income in your 2nd House, while Venus conjunct Mercury in Virgo, your 6th House, makes love practical. Thursday's Sun conjunct Venus sharpens affection, but Mercury's approaching square to Jupiter in Gemini, your 3rd House, warns against overpromising. Friday is the turning point: Pluto in Aquarius pressures career decisions in your 10th House. Monday's Moon trines Jupiter, expanding conversations and opportunities. Tuesday supports repairs as Mars sextiles Saturn in Aries, your 12th House; the Moon opposes Pluto in Aquarius, your 10th House, creating pressure. Wednesday is your power day because Venus conjunct Mercury joins affection with care. Tuesday is your weakest day because the Moon opposes Pluto, intensifying pressure. Set one clear boundary before a conversation today. Follow for daily updates.
